He rises by earning the trust of the warlords who shelter him -- Gongsun Zan, Kong Rong, Tao Qian, Liu Biao, Liu Yan, Ma Teng and the Sun clan -- who reward that trust with bonuses to his militia and, in time, with their own finest officers. Turn on a patron and that path closes for good.[[/i]]\\n\\n[[i]][[col:flavour]]The way towards unity and everlasting peace should be achieved through compassion and cohesion.[[/col]][[/i]]
